description: Find a company, a bank or another legal entity in Atlas, the map of the relationships between companies, by part of its name, its LEI or the id of a covered company. Returns each entity's id (used by get_relationships and find_connections), its country, LEI, the covered company that it is or whose group it belongs to (Citibank, N.A. to citigroup), and its number of links.

country.description: ISO 3166 country code, for example US, SG or JP

query.description: part of a name, an LEI or a company id, for example JPMorgan Chase Bank or boeing

name: search_entities
title: Search the entities of Atlas
